# boss-agent-cli

> A BOSS Zhipin (BOSS 直聘) CLI for people and AI agents. Job discovery with real welfare filtering, applications, recruiter workflows, resumes, AI assistance and recoverable crawling share one capability set behind a single JSON envelope. Current version: 3.0.0.

## Capability source of truth

Run `boss schema` (also supports `--format native | openai-tools | anthropic-tools | mcp-tools`). 39 top-level commands, 14 first-level recruiter subcommands, 78 implemented MCP tools. The sole registered platform is zhipin (BOSS Zhipin).

## Start here

- [Agent quickstart](docs/agent-quickstart.md) — envelope contract, error recovery, risk-stop rules
- [Command reference](docs/commands.md)

## Install

- MCP server: `uvx --from boss-agent-cli[mcp] boss-mcp`
- CLI: `uv tool install boss-agent-cli`
- Browser core (login / export only): `patchright install chromium`

## Contract

Every command emits exactly one JSON envelope to stdout: `{ok, schema_version, command, data, pagination, error, hints}`. Logs and terminal displays go to stderr. `exit 0` ⇔ `ok=true`; `exit 1` ⇔ `ok=false` by default — opt-in `--exit-codes sysexits` maps error classes to sysexits codes (77 auth, 75 temp-fail, 78 config, 69 unavailable). Errors carry `code`, `recoverable` and `recovery_action`.

## Boundaries

Platform risk codes or security pages stop the workflow and save a checkpoint; resume is explicit and user-driven. Do not bypass risk controls, parallelize requests, or retry indefinitely. Local-first: no telemetry, data stays on this machine.
